description: Na₂BHO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and five O atoms. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.45 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and six O atoms. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.57 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.64 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.45 Å) B-O bond length. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.54 Å) H-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to three equivalent Na, one B, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one B, and one H atom.
